title: CE41026: Disaster Resistant Design Of Structures
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Disasters : earthquake, cyclone, flood, tsunami, land slide, fire, blasting
etc. Behaviour and characteristics of materials : steel and concrete.
Different architectural forms to resist different disasters. Basic
characteristics of disasters : its behaviour and important parameters.
Ductility design. Design basis for disaster resistant structural design. Fire
resistant structural design. Different codal provisions.
